articles.title: Bihar Cop Found Dead Amid Alleged Harassment by Female Colleague; Wife 5 Months Pregnant
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gaya, Bihar – The death of 30-year-old Sub-Inspector Anuj Kashyap has sent shockwaves through the Bihar Police force. Anuj, a 2019-batch officer posted in Gaya, was found hanging in his rented house in Mohan Nagar, just 300 meters from the SP’s residence.

body.html:
Gaya, Bihar – The death of 30-year-old Sub-Inspector Anuj Kashyap has sent shockwaves through the Bihar Police force. Anuj, a 2019-batch officer posted in Gaya, was found hanging in his rented house in Mohan Nagar, just 300 meters from the SP’s residence.

According to police, Anuj’s colleagues discovered his body on the morning of August 8 after repeated calls went unanswered. Forensic and FSL teams have seized his mobile phone for technical analysis, with investigators examining call logs and chats for clues.

Anuj’s father, Bhavnath Mishra, has accused female Sub-Inspector Sweety Kumari — his son’s batchmate from training — of relentless harassment and pressuring him to leave his pregnant wife and marry her. He claims the pressure had been ongoing for six months, driving his son into depression.

Anuj, married in May 2022, leaves behind a wife in Delhi who is five months pregnant and preparing for the UPSC exam. His father has demanded a CBI inquiry and strict legal action against Sweety Kumari, alleging her role in his son’s death.

Rampur Police have registered a murder case against Sweety Kumari, and the investigation is ongoing.

body.html:
Udhampur – In a disturbing case of dowry violence, Raveen Begum from Malhar was allegedly beaten mercilessly by her husband, Azam Ali, a serving soldier, after she refused his demands for ₹10 lakh in cash and a car.

Her family has accused Azam of long-standing harassment and physical abuse over dowry. Following their complaint, Rehambal Police registered an FIR under sections related to dowry harassment and cruelty by husband or relatives. The accused has been arrested, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Slippergate: Viral Video Exposes Gender Equality Hypocrisy in India
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video circulating widely on social media shows a woman repeatedly striking a man with a slipper, while the man remains calm and adjusts his hairstyle. The footage has triggered a fierce online debate on gender equality and the perceived double standards in law enforcement.

body.html:
A video circulating widely on social media shows a woman repeatedly striking a man with a slipper, while the man remains calm and adjusts his hairstyle. The footage has triggered a fierce online debate on gender equality and the perceived double standards in law enforcement.

Social media users have pointed out that when men assault women, the public response is to urge legal action, but when women attack men, the blame often shifts to the victim. The incident has fuelled calls for gender-neutral laws and the creation of a “Men’s Commission” to address men’s safety and legal rights.

The hashtag #पुरुषआयोग_बनाओ is trending, with many demanding dedicated helplines and legal protection for men. Advocates stress that violence, regardless of gender, is unacceptable and every case should be judged on facts, not stereotypes.

articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Amroha, Uttar Pradesh – In a shocking incident, policemen allegedly under the influence of alcohol brutally assaulted tea seller Shamshuddin, his son Shakib, and Shahadat in Rajabpur. The dispute reportedly began over taking goods from the kiosk.

body.html:
Amroha, Uttar Pradesh – In a shocking incident, policemen allegedly under the influence of alcohol brutally assaulted tea seller Shamshuddin, his son Shakib, and Shahadat in Rajabpur. The dispute reportedly began over taking goods from the kiosk.

Following an inquiry by the City CO, constables Rahul Bhati and Vijay were found guilty and suspended. Inspector Akash Kumar, constable Rahul Rana, and constable Deepak Tomar were held negligent and transferred to the police lines. A departmental probe is underway.

articles.title: Wife, Lover Brutally Beat Husband, Kept Him Untreated for 3 Days
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mumbai’s Aarey Colony Police have arrested 35-year-old makeup artist Rajshree Ahire for conspiring with her lover to murder her husband, Bharat Laxman Ahire.

body.html:
Mumbai’s Aarey Colony Police have arrested 35-year-old makeup artist Rajshree Ahire for conspiring with her lover to murder her husband, Bharat Laxman Ahire.

Police said Bharat was assaulted on July 15 in Goregaon by Rajshree’s lover Chandrashekhar Padayachi and his associate Ranga, following a dispute over her alleged affair. Chandrashekhar repeatedly punched Bharat while Ranga restrained him, and Rajshree did not intervene.

Instead of seeking medical help, Rajshree kept her injured husband at home for three days. Her 13-year-old daughter alerted relatives about his worsening condition. Rajshree later claimed he was hurt in a bike accident, but Bharat died in a Malad hospital on August 5.

The daughter’s statement led to Rajshree’s arrest. Chandrashekhar and Ranga remain absconding.
